newsitem.title: LUXEMBOURG: Council sets guidelines for future trade accords.
newsitem.headline: Council sets guidelines for future trade accords.

text.p: The General Affairs Council agreed on Tuesday that priority should be given in planning for future preferential trade deals to countries with whom the EU has already made a commitment.
"The text says that priority must be placed on those with whom we have already committed ourselves," a European Commission spokesman said.

The June 16-17 European Council in Amsterdam will be asked to say whether it can agee with this line, which has been settled as part of a process of ensuring the EU policy is in line with criteria laid down by the World Trade Organisation.
